stored.a: On your phone, and in your phone's own backup (Google) if you've turned it on; on Android, only when that backup is end-to-end encrypted. On iPhone, your journal isn't in your iCloud backup. Piggybow has no account and no server for your money notes.

newPhone.q: Can I move to a new phone?
newPhone.a: On Android, yes: to a new Android phone, if your phone backs up your apps, restore that backup on the new phone. Piggybow is only in a cloud backup when your phone has a screen lock, so the backup is encrypted. Android 8 and older don't back it up at all. App lock turns off after a restore, so turn it on again in Me. On iPhone, your journal isn't in your iCloud backup, so restoring one won't bring it back. Moving between Android and iPhone isn't possible yet. You can always keep a copy: Me → Export my data gives you a spreadsheet file (CSV) to save or send.

delete.q: How do I delete my data?
delete.a: In the app, go to Me → Delete all my data. That erases everything Piggybow stored on your phone. Piggybow has no server, so nothing is stored with us. On Android, copies in your phone's own backup are managed in your Google account settings.

advice.a: No. The pig's ideas are everyday saving habits, not financial, tax or investment advice.

pin.a: Tap "Forgot PIN?" and use your phone's own screen lock (fingerprint, face, PIN or pattern) to get in, then choose a new PIN. If your phone has no screen lock, the only way back in is to erase Piggybow's data on your phone and start over.

terms.title: Piggybow Terms of Use
terms.description: The terms for using Piggybow, a private money journal, and Piggybow Plus, its subscription.
terms.intro: These terms are an agreement between you and [DRAFT] BurrowSoft's legal name, [DRAFT] country ("we", "us") about using the Piggybow app. By using Piggybow, you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.

what.body: Piggybow is a personal money journal. You write down what you spend and save, and the app keeps those notes on your phone. Piggybow isn't a bank, doesn't move money, and doesn't connect to your bank.

advice.body: Piggybow's ideas and tips are everyday saving habits. They aren't financial, tax, legal or investment advice. Decisions about your money are yours.

yours.body: What you write in Piggybow belongs to you. It stays on your phone. If your phone's own backup is turned on, it may also be in that backup, only when that backup is end-to-end encrypted on Android. We don't receive it. You can export it or delete it at any time in the app.
yours.privacy: The Privacy Policy explains this in full:
yours.phone: Because your journal lives on your phone, keeping your phone and its backups safe is up to you. If your phone is lost, reset or replaced without a backup, we can't restore your journal.

age.body: Piggybow is meant for adults, aged 18 and over.

plus.intro: Some features are part of Piggybow Plus, a subscription you can buy inside the app.
plus.prices: Prices are shown in the app before you buy, in your local currency, as set by Google Play or the App Store.
plus.payment: Payment is handled by Google Play or the App Store under their terms. We never see your card details.
plus.renew: at the end of each period unless you cancel before it ends (on the App Store, at least 24 hours before). You can cancel anytime in your Google Play or App Store subscription settings.
plus.notCancelBefore: Uninstalling the app or deleting your data does
plus.trial: If a free trial is offered, it turns into a paid subscription at the end of the trial unless you cancel before then.
plus.refunds: Refunds are handled by Google Play or the App Store under their refund policies.
plus.ends: If your subscription ends, you keep everything you've written. Plus-only features stop until you subscribe again.

fair.body: Please don't try to break, reverse-engineer or misuse the app, or use it to break the law.

changes.h: 7. Changes to the app and these terms
changes.body: We may update Piggybow and these terms. If we make a change that matters, we'll say so in the app or on this page before it takes effect. If you keep using Piggybow after that, the new terms apply.

warranty.body: We work hard to make Piggybow reliable, but it's provided "as is". We can't promise it will always be free of errors or available.

liability.body: As far as the law allows, we aren't responsible for indirect losses, or for losses caused by lost data, money decisions, or events outside our control. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under consumer law that can't be limited.

law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of [DRAFT] country / jurisdiction, without taking away any protection your local consumer law gives you.
